label: in the cockpit: active, the HUD up, the camera at the ship, the button's other word
eval: JSON.stringify({ ...__map.pilot.stats(), fov: __map.map.camera.fov, hud: !document.getElementById('cockpit').hidden, button: document.getElementById('btn-pilot').textContent, previewHidden: document.getElementById('preview-box').hidden, camAtShip: Math.round(__map.map.camera.position.distanceTo(__map.pilot.ship.position)), battle: __map.map.battle.enabled })

label: heading after ArrowLeft for 2.5 s: it turned
eval: (() => { const h = __map.pilot.forward().toArray(); const dot = h[0]*__h0[0]+h[1]*__h0[1]+h[2]*__h0[2]; return JSON.stringify({ heading: h.map((v) => v.toFixed(2)), turnedDegrees: Math.round(Math.acos(Math.min(1, dot)) * 180 / Math.PI) }); })()

label: Space fired the cannons: shots, and bolts in the battle
an aimed shot: a TIE is held 60 m dead ahead, then Space
eval: (() => { const p = __map.pilot; const b = __map.map.battle; let tie = b.fighters.find((f) => f.kind === 'tie' && f.alive); if (!tie) { b.spawnFighter('empire', __map.map.camera); tie = b.fighters.find((f) => f.kind === 'tie' && f.alive); } tie.obj.position.copy(p.ship.position).addScaledVector(p.forward(), 60); tie.speed = 0; tie.turn = 0; p.target = tie; window.__k0 = p.kills; return JSON.stringify({ kills: p.kills, ties: p.ties().length, targetAt: Math.round(tie.obj.position.distanceTo(p.ship.position)) }); })()
